name: my-shop
description: My Shop — Arabic-first point-of-sale and back-office system for a small independent retail business.

scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:typecheck && npm run testkit:typecheck && npm run api:typecheck
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @my-shop/contracts && npm run build --workspace @my-shop/testkit && npm run build --workspace @my-shop/api
scripts.gates: npm run gate:secret-scan && npm run gate:markdown && npm run gate:import-boundary && npm run gate:vocabulary && npm run gate:localization && npm run gate:design-system && npm run gate:immutability && npm run gate:offline && npm run gate:migrations
scripts.verify: npm run toolchain:verify && npm run gates && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run flutter:analyze && npm run flutter:test
scripts.verify:node: npm run toolchain:verify && npm run gates && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:flutter: npm run flutter:analyze && npm run flutter:test
